title: Karl Kesel
description: What inspired Karl Kesel to illustrate Jabba's rock'n'roll trio? "I drew them because they're wacky, and I like wacky. And Boba Fett was taken." Kesel began working in the comics field in 1984, naturally gravitating toward uncommercial characters (AMETHYST, 'MAZING MAN, etc.). He's recently illustrated a series of STAR WARS Young Adult novels, is currently writing and drawing an INDIANA JONES mini-series, and became the regular writer on ADVENTURES OF SUPERMAN just in time to watch him die.
